2.88.43
Chart.PlotArea
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Chart.PlotArea element specifies properties for a PlotArea. This element is optional. This element
is of type PlotArea.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.PlotArea element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.PlotArea element.
 <xsd:element name="PlotArea" type="PlotAreaType" minOccurs="0" />
